scope: Post-outcome developmental test of a winner-preserving shortlist mode over the frozen four-group common-roster panel. It is not untouched confirmation.
candidate_roster: Exact common ten-backbone roster inherited from the expanded reliability analysis.
feature_policy: Exactly the prior OI-only feature schema; no head, envelope, candidate-identity, or dataset-identity feature.

alternative.winner_rule: Preserve the complete first broad-RFF tie-group exactly and unconditionally.
alternative.fill_rule: Within the remaining broad top-10 pool, order candidates by an equal weighted average of broad and SAVE ordinal scores.
alternative.outside_pool_rule: Retain broad ordering; vacuous for the frozen ten-candidate roster.

gate.standardization: training-group mean and population standard deviation
gate.target: broad top-five mean regret minus winner-preserved alternative top-five mean regret
gate.decision: use the winner-preserved alternative iff predicted benefit > 0; otherwise use broad

bootstrap.unit: joint replicate position across all five target families

decision.primary: upper95 gated-minus-broad top-five mean utility regret < 0
required_invariants: first rank group exactly equals broad in every panel

interpretation: A pass supports this formulation as a development candidate for a future untouched continuous target. It does not erase the observed gap to the linear probe.
